description.value: Red Wagon Caf'EH is a neighbourhood café on Ryan Road East in the Courtenay area of Vancouver Island, pouring Red Tree coffee alongside freshly baked goods, sandwiches, and housemade bread. Its casual, community-oriented feel and food-forward menu make it a natural mid-ride stop for cyclists passing through the Comox Valley corridor.
